_note: The Gyre, level 13: islands in an endless storm. See docs/zones.md.

gyre.name: the Gyre
gyre.description: Islands that float in a storm that never ends.

gy_sky1.name: Open Sky
gy_sky1.description: The skiff heels over in the wind. Below: nothing at all, for ever.

gy_sky2.name: The Squall Line
gy_sky2.description: Rain sideways. The skiff's kite strains.

gy_sky3.name: The Downdraught
gy_sky3.description: The skiff drops like a stone, and catches.

gy_landing.name: The Tear
gy_landing.description: A rip in the sky, stitched open with ropes. Through it, the snows of the Cold Spine.

gy_docks.name: Kitefast Docks
gy_docks.description: Skiffs with kites for sails, tethered to an island in the clouds.

gy_loft.name: The Kite Loft
gy_loft.description: A loft of kite-silk and spars, out of the wind.

gy_isle.name: Shearwater Isle
gy_isle.description: A wind-scoured island no bigger than a field. The edges crumble.

gy_cliffs.name: The Gull Cliffs
gy_cliffs.description: Narrow ledges where storm-hawks nest. The wind wants you off.

trap.name: a gust off the ledge
trap.hit: A gust takes your feet out from under you, and the ledge's edge catches you, just.
trap.avoid: You flatten yourself against the rock as the gust goes by.

sign.name: ledges
sign.text: The ledges to the east are narrow, and the gusts come every few breaths.

gy_crag.name: Roc's Crag
gy_crag.description: A spire of rock in the storm, white with droppings. Bones everywhere.

gy_nest.name: The Roc's Nest
gy_nest.description: A nest of whole trees on top of the crag.

gy_fall.name: The Long Fall
gy_fall.description: The lowest island, where everything falls in the end. Below, far below, a grey steppe of bones.

features.edge: Jump, and you'd land, eventually, on the steppe below.

tavi.name: Skymaster Tavi
tavi.label: Skymaster
tavi.description: a wiry woman roped to the dock, grinning into the wind
tavi.details: A wiry woman roped to the dock, grinning into the wind.

work.text: Ask me about the kites, or the roc. Or just take a skiff: they go to Shearwater and the Crag.
work.explains: Type TRAVEL here to see the skiffs and their fares.

kites.text: Storm-hawk silk makes the best kites. Five hawks, from the Gull Cliffs on Shearwater.

roc.text: The Thunder Roc nests on its crag and takes my skiffs out of the air. Kill it and I'll make you a hero. Its dive: dodge.

topics.fall: From Shearwater, a skiff goes down to the Long Fall. People jump from there. Some say they land.

storm_hawk_1.label: Hawk
storm_hawk_1.description: a hawk with lightning in its feathers

wind_elemental_1.name: Wind Elemental
wind_elemental_1.label: Elemental
wind_elemental_1.description: a spinning shape of wind and grit
wind_elemental_1.details: A spinning shape of wind and grit.

wind_elemental_2.name: Wind Elemental
wind_elemental_2.label: Elemental
wind_elemental_2.description: a spinning shape of wind and grit
wind_elemental_2.details: A spinning shape of wind and grit.

thunder_roc.name: the Thunder Roc
thunder_roc.label: Roc
thunder_roc.description: a bird the size of a ship, crackling
thunder_roc.details: A bird the size of a ship, crackling.

attacks.name: thunder-dive
attacks.hit: {actor} dives on {target} in a crack of thunder!

roc_glaive.name: Roc-feather Glaive
roc_glaive.description: A glaive fletched with the Roc's feathers. It loves a wild wind.

skyrigger_harness.name: Skyrigger's Harness
skyrigger_harness.description: A harness with a tether-hook. +2 Poise.

skiff-shearwater.name: the Shearwater skiff
skiff-shearwater.depart: You cast off. The kite fills with a crack.
skiff-shearwater.arrive: {actor}'s skiff bumps in to the island.

skiff-shearwater-back.name: the Shearwater skiff
skiff-shearwater-back.depart: You cast off back to Kitefast.

skiff-crag.name: the crag skiff
skiff-crag.depart: You cast off. The kite fills with a crack.
skiff-crag.arrive: {actor}'s skiff bumps in to the island.

skiff-crag-back.name: the crag skiff
skiff-crag-back.depart: You cast off back to Kitefast.

skiff-fall.name: the fall skiff
skiff-fall.depart: You steer the skiff down, and down.
skiff-fall.arrive: {actor}'s skiff lands hard on the lowest island.

skiff-fall-back.name: the fall skiff
skiff-fall-back.depart: You claw the skiff back up the wind.

summit-tear.name: the tear in the sky
summit-tear.depart: You lean into the gale, and the sky lets you in.
summit-tear.closed: The rip in the sky is only a shimmer. It opens in a strong wind.

gyre-tear.name: the tear
gyre-tear.depart: You climb back through the tear, into the cold.
gyre-tear.arrive: {actor} drops out of the sky onto the summit.

long-fall.name: the Long Fall
long-fall.depart: You step off the edge. The fall takes a very long time.
long-fall.arrive: {actor} drops out of the sky and lands, impossibly, on their feet.

gyre_gust.text: A gust heels the skiff right over. Your feet leave the deck.

success.text: You catch a line and hang on.

failure.text: You go over, and catch the hull with your fingertips. It takes a long time to climb back.

success.text: You hug the deck until it rights.

failure.text: You slide straight off. A tether on the kite catches you, and drags you home.

kill.goal: Kill five storm-hawks (the skiff to Shearwater: TRAVEL SHEARWATER ISLE).

back.goal: Tell Tavi: ASK TAVI ABOUT KITES.

kill.goal: Kill the Thunder Roc on its nest (the skiff to the Crag: TRAVEL ROC'S CRAG).

back.goal: Tell Tavi: ASK TAVI ABOUT ROC.
